description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a self-serve hot pot chain with a location on North Vancouver's West Esplanade, offering individually served pots with over 100 fresh ingredients and more than 18 broth and dry-mix options. Diners customize their meal from premium meats, seafood, and fresh vegetables cooked tableside in broths ranging from Signature Mala to collagen pork bone. The restaurant is part of a rapidly expanding BC-based chain with a rewards program and app-based ordering.
